newsitem.title: USA: ConEd faces NRC fines at N.Y. Indian Pt nuke.
newsitem.headline: ConEd faces NRC fines at N.Y. Indian Pt nuke.

text.p: The Nuclear Regulatory Commission (NRC) said Wednesday it proposed a $205,000 fine against Consolidated Edison Co of New York (ConEd) for alleged safety violations at its Indian Point 2 nuclear power plant.

The NRC, in a prepared statement, cited six infractions that involve "failure to identify and/or correct problems at the plant between June 1995 and March of this year, resulting in conditions the NRC considers 'adverse to quality.'"
A seventh alleged violation related to inadequate fire protection measures, the commission said.
ConEd, operator of the 975 megawatt facility at Indian Point, N.Y., has 30 days to pay the fine or request in writing that all or part be withdrawn, the statement said.
The unit is currently shut for a scheduled refueling outage that began May 1 and is set to last about 43 days.
